# 佛說犯戒罪報輕重經

**ID:** T1467b
**Volume:** T24
**Category:** 律部類
**Original Category:** 律部
**Date:** 148–170
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T1467b

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle variant recension of [KR6k0055](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0055) (the *Fóshuō fànjiè zuìbào qīngzhòng jīng* attributed to An Shigao). The Taishō entry T1467 is divided into two sub-recensions (a and b); this is the variant transmission stream. Translator unknown.

**Abstract**

The two-recension transmission of the *Fànjiè zuìbào* sūtra reflects the textual instability characteristic of short-form Vinaya-related *sūtras* in the early Chinese Buddhist tradition. The variant differs from [KR6k0055](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0055) in details of phrasing and in the order of the karmic consequences enumerated. Comparative philological work (Nattier 2008) treats both recensions as valuable witnesses to the earliest Chinese Vinaya-derived translations.
